**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document contains no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-fee-on-termination provision. Supporting points:

- § 7.1 affirmatively prohibits Vendor from imposing minimum-use or similar charges not identified in the Order Form.
- § 7.3 bars interest on disputed amounts ultimately found not due.
- § 27.3 permits Customer to terminate for prolonged force majeure "without penalty," with a refund of prepaid Fees.
- § 10.2 and § 21.1 are refund/mutual-cap provisions that impose no Customer-side liquidated amount.

This sits at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback. The § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment is the only closest analogue, but it is a minimum purchase commitment properly handled under the MINCOMMIT rule, so I have not double-flagged it here.
